with recursive selected_menu as ( select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.label, m.icon, m.path, m.hidden, m.sort_order from dp_menu m join dp_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id join dp_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id join dp_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0 and m.deleted = 0 ), page_tree as ( select id, parent_id, label, icon, path, hidden, sort_order from selected_menu union select parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.label, parent.icon, parent.path, parent.hidden, parent.sort_order from dp_menu parent join page_tree child on child.parent_id = parent.id where parent.deleted = 0 ) select distinct id, parent_id, label, icon, path, hidden, sort_order from page_tree order by parent_id, sort_order, id
